acceptanceCriteria.ac: Error counts tracked per category: I2C, TIMEOUT, LIMIT, ESTOP, POSLOS. ERRCNT returns "OK I2C:3 TIMEOUT:1 LIMIT:5 ESTOP:2 POSLOS:0"
Per-axis error counts: ERRCNT X returns "OK X LIMIT:2 POSLOS:0 TIMEOUT:1"
ERROR events published with context: "EVENT ERROR SYSTEM E020" for I2C, "EVENT ERROR axis code" for axis errors
CLRERR command clears error state: CLRERR X clears X axis error, CLRERR clears all
Error state clearable via axis re-enable: EN X 1 clears error state
Unsafe operations blocked in ERROR state: MOVE/VEL returns "ERROR ERR_AXIS_ERROR MSG_CLEAR_ERROR_FIRST"
ERRCNT CLR resets all error counts to zero
STAT command correctly reports ERROR state and error code

dependencies.esp-idf: FreeRTOS (mutex for thread safety), ESP-IDF logging

constraints.constraint: Header-Only Configuration: Every configurable value MUST be defined in a header file. Use CMD_ERRCNT, ERR_AXIS_ERROR etc. from config_commands.h. Never hardcode values.
Command handlers follow posok_handler.cpp pattern: CommandEntry with handler function, register via cmd_executor_register()
Safety modules follow position_loss pattern: init/deinit, state tracking, extern "C" for C++ compatibility
Error counts accessed from multiple tasks - use FreeRTOS mutex for protection. Follow mcp23017_wrapper mutex pattern.
System errors: "EVENT ERROR SYSTEM code", Axis errors: "EVENT ERROR axis code". Use EVTTYPE_ERROR from response_formatter.h
ERRCNT all: "OK I2C:n TIMEOUT:n LIMIT:n ESTOP:n POSLOS:n", ERRCNT axis: "OK X LIMIT:n POSLOS:n TIMEOUT:n"
